productNotes.what: A new Stage while an arrangement Apply is unresolved is REFUSED with an error toast ('still unresolved … Check result / Retry same Apply / Forget kept request'). The 2026-10-06 review's R2 repro ('stage arrangement B while A applies') is therefore structurally blocked; the surviving R2 hazard is Undo during flight, which flow 13 exercises (the undo-revealed staging survives the commit as stale, drafts adopt only the committed map).

The arrangement bar persists as a 'Nothing staged' empty state whenever the undo stack is non-empty (UX7); the Stage button label is dynamic ('Stage N channel moves'). The harness now locates the Stage button by .jw-btn-primary class and distinguishes .jw-arrange-bar-empty.

Observed failing (1 failed / 490 passed) against an earlier revision of the uncommitted backend diff: the test's base arrange_range (2 channels, already in name order inside 300-306) is a genuine planner noop, contradicting its own 'must do something' premise. The backend owner amended the test (3 channels, range 295-306) while verification was running; the final suite is 491 passed, exit 0. No product change was involved.
